headlines.title: Starbucks targets 40,000 stores abroad, opening '3 new coffeehouses a day'
headlines.summary: Starbucks (SBUX) Chairman and CEO Brian Niccol outlines an aggressive global turnaround plan to open three new coffeehouses a day, expand overseas locations to nearly 40,000, and invest in employee advancement and coaching programs.

headlines.title: Starbucks cashes in on matcha hype: 'Almost everyone puts a cold foam on it'
headlines.summary: During Starbucks (SBUX)' earnings call, Chief Financial Officer Cathy Smith and Chairman & CEO Brian Niccol highlight how cold-drink customizations — especially cold foam — have propelled their matcha business past $1 billion and fueled afternoon traffic growth.

headlines.title: Earnings round-up: Sandisk tops estimates, while Starbucks & Reddit fall short
headlines.summary: Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley takes a closer look at several companies that reported earnings results on Thursday, including Sandisk (SNDK), Starbucks (SBUX), and Reddit (RDDT).

headlines.title: Starbucks Is Winning Back Customers. Now Profits Are Following.
headlines.summary: CEO Brian Niccol says his turnaround plan is now becoming the coffee chain’s growth plan.

headlines.title: SBUX Stock Heads For Third Green Week: CEO Says Starbucks Is 'Ahead Of Schedule' In Fiscal 2028 Goal — 'Our Coffeehouses Are Coffeehouses Again'
headlines.summary: Starbucks CEO Brian Niccol touts turnaround progress, stronger U.S. sales and improving customer traffic.

description: Starbucks Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a roaster, marketer, and retailer of coffee internationally. The company operates through three segments: North America, International, and Channel Development. Its stores offer coffee, tea, and other beverages, roasted whole beans and ground coffees, complementary food, packaged coffees, single-serve products, and ready-to-drink beverages; and various food products, such as pastries, breakfast sandwiches, and lunch items. The company also licenses its trademarks through licensed stores, and grocery and foodservice accounts. The company offers its products under the Starbucks Coffee, Teavana, Seattle's Best Coffee, Ethos, and Starbucks Reserve brands. Starbucks Corporation was founded in 1971 and is based in Seattle, Washington.
